brief_rationale: The doctor clearly distinguished preoperative risk disclosure from actual complications (RC2 met), screened for acute danger signals (RC3 met), integrated vital signs and history (RC4/R5 met), built a communication checklist (RC6/R7 met), addressed family decision-making (RC8 met), and provided safe timeline and responsible clinicians (RC9 met). No serious or minor responsibility-chain error occurred. High-order points HO1 (communication adaptation) and HO2 (practical family communication steps) were both actively completed with case-specific, beyond-minimum actions, and HO4 (bounded closure) was partially completed. Because zero in-chain errors exist and at least two high-order points are complete, the grade reaches 5 (Perfect).
